newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dehaene may accept third term as Belgian PM.
newsitem.headline: Dehaene may accept third term as Belgian PM.

text.p: Jean-Luc Dehaene could be willing to take a third term as Belgian prime minister after the 1999 elections, his office said on Monday.
"If it depends on Dehaene himself, he will not seek a third term. But there could be situations in which it is not possible to refuse to be prime minister," his spokeswoman said.
She added that Dehaene would definitely be a candidate in the 1999 elections.
"Dehaene will not cling to power, but he will not flee his responsibility when he is called upon," she said.
On October 7, Dehaene told the newspapers La Libre Belgique and De Standaard he would bid for a third term as prime minister.
